description: For each listed query: add an adapter in benchbox/core/tpcds/dataframe_queries/parameter_adapters.py from dsqgen -LOG names to the DataFrame keys (reproduce template arithmetic); make the implementation read the mapped keys with no literal fallback (Q83 currently has one); delete dead YAML keys in default_parameters.yaml; remove the query from BINDING_GAP (and LITERAL_FALLBACK) in tests/unit/core/tpcds/test_parameter_consumption_inventory.py. Q66 needs its four per-seed column choices (web_sales_col, catalog_sales_col, web_net_col, catalog_net_col, added in PR #2539) mapped from SALESONE, SALESTWO, NETONE, NETTWO. Q70 has a latent top-5 state filter (dfparity-t08b). Follow the t04 pattern. queries.py PRs queue one at a time. Effort about 2 days (judgement).
